hooks.command: head -n 20 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/reminder.txt" 2>/dev/null; for c in python3 python py; do "$c" -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; done; echo "AI+ setup: Python 3 was not found. Before other work, tell the user in one line why AI+ needs it (the agent notice, prompt nudge, end-of-turn evidence check, connector injection screen and plugin scan run on Python; the core rules work without it), then ask whether to install it now: Windows: winget install -e --id Python.Python.3.12 ; macOS: brew install python ; Linux: sudo apt install python3 . Install only after a clear yes, then verify with python --version."; exit 0

for c in python3 python py; do "$c" -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec "$c" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/agent_notice.py"; done; exit 0
